title: Puteanus: the material object of our adoration can be the image alone
source_text: XLV. Eadem est etiam Puteani Doctrina, qui agnoscit imaginem Christi, ac proinde sancti cujusvis imaginem, sic adorari posse, ut adorationis nostrae objectum materiale sit imago sola. In tertiam partem Thomae quaestione vigesima quinta Articulo tertio.
pass_a_gloss: The same is also the Doctrine of Puteanus, who acknowledges that the image of Christ, and accordingly the image of any saint, can be so adored that the material object of our adoration is the image alone. On the third part of Thomas, question twenty-five, article three.
pass_b_english: Puteanus agrees: Christ's image—and any saint's—can be adored so that the material object is the image alone (on ST III q.25 a.3).

choices.why: Named School ally of Suarez and Bellarmine here.
